parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.
en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh-CN：中文
en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name instance configuration. You can configure both A and AAAA records for the same access domain name and GTM instance. In this case, two domain name instance configurations are generated for the GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a domain name instance configuration
parameters.help_zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The alert configuration mode of the instance. Valid values:

global: Inherits the instance alert configuration. The instance uses the instance alert configuration.

instance_config: Uses a custom alert configuration
parameters.help_zh:
实例告警配置模式：

global：继承全局报警配置，即实例采用全局告警配置

instance_config：自定义报警配置
parameters.name: alert_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of alert notification groups
parameters.name: alert_group

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to configure DingTalk alert notifications. Valid values:

true: Configured. A DingTalk notification is sent when an alert event occurs.

false: Not configured
fields.help_zh:
是否配置钉钉报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

false：未配置
fields.name: dingtalk_notice

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to configure email alert notifications. Valid values:

true: Configured. An email notification is sent when an alert event occurs.

false: Not configured
fields.help_zh:
是否配置邮件报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送邮件通知

false：未配置
fields.name: email_notice

fields.help_en:
The alert event type. Valid values:

addr_alert: The address is unavailable.

addr_resume: The address recovers to active.

addr_pool_unavailable: The IPAM pool is unavailable.

addr_pool_available: The IPAM pool recovers to active
fields.help_zh:
报警事件类型：

addr_alert：地址不可用

addr_resume：地址恢复可用

addr_pool_unavailable：地址池不可用

addr_pool_available：地址池恢复可用
fields.name: notice_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to configure SMS alert notifications. Valid values:

true: Configured. An SMS notification is sent when an alert event occurs.

false: Not configured.

SMS notifications are supported only on the China site and are not supported on the International site
fields.help_zh:
是否配置短信报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送短信通知

false：未配置

仅中国站支持短信通知，国际站不支持短信通知
fields.name: sms_notice
